extension.summary: Read-only Dex Hub widget organiser for Dex Glass
extension.description: Filters the public Dex Hub Continue Watching listings into film and episode rows. Uses the official installed Dex Hub plugin and Kodi JSON-RPC without copying Dex Hub code or credentials.
extension.license: MIT (original Dex Glass bridge code only)
extension.disclaimer: Experimental. Needs the separately installed official Dex Hub add-on.
